mathematics.assertion_tested: Finite exact kernel/rank identities and factorization equivalence, one symbolic quadratic polynomial identity, bounded polyphase Hankel determinant identities, and theorem-label/source-literal contracts.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact SymPy integer, rational, and polynomial algebra over Q.
mathematics.conventions: A,B have the same source-column count; nullspace bases represent K_A,K_B, sum/intersection dimensions use exact rank. The factorization gate compares kernel inclusion with stacked row rank. Hankel entries e0^T(I+S)^n e0 use cyclic shift S[0,N-1]=z.
non_claims: No proof of universal semantic quotient, factorization, or admissibility statements.
The semantic dimension count does not construct or check exact-sequence maps.
Quadratic identity alone does not verify analytic convexity hypotheses.
No negative-control mutation suite is built into the original Block17 verifier.
Source-label checks are not proof audits, independent peer review, or novelty verification.

randomness.generator: Python random.Random (Mersenne Twister); seed set in unchanged verifier
